source_selection: first 16 entries in frozen dev200 order, fixed before final checkpoint selection
checkpoint_selection: minimum mean D=MSE+0.1 LPIPS across 200 sources x three actual budgets at steps1000/2000/3000/4000/5000; first step on ties
extra_metric_scope: only 16 x 3 actual budgets x F0/scalar/progressive; cache identical pixels; no extra metrics at all257 endpoints or all checkpoints
materialization: Training evaluation saved scores but not native pixels or streams. This is separately registered deterministic materialization, with same selected checkpoint/device/math and exact MSE validation against saved chosen-j rows; saved LPIPS reused. New anchors scored only where no saved chosen-j result exists.
budget: Within existing B48 GPU-device hours/16 CPU-worker hours; each materialization role<=3600s; each metric role<=3600s; no wireless, second seed, lambda or long training here
independence: RX CDF memo comes only from earlier independent source reception, keyed by actual decoded prefix. No TX CDF or full latent passed to RX. Canonical mixed AC must match received bits.
statistics: Descriptive fixed development subset; no bootstrap or independent-test claim; selected-checkpoint full200 metrics remain primary
